summary: Philip Gahn died in a fall from Andrews Glacier into rocks, Rocky Mountain National Park
location: Andrews Glacier, Rocky Mountain National Park
notes: DATE CORRECTED to 2012-07-12 (was 2012-07-13): NPS morning report (Mon Jul 16, 2012) says the fatality occurred 'last Thursday' (Jul 12); NPT corroborates 'Thursday afternoon'. 100summits list's 7/13 likely death-declaration/date-of-record. NPS incident details: with friends descending Andrews Glacier, slipped/slid ~100 ft into rocks; trail crew reached body 3:35 p.m.; flown to Glacier Basin Campground helispot 6:15 p.m.; transferred to Larimer County Coroner. | NPS ROMO morning-report compendium URL merged (run 487).
